content.title: Hard-Cut Soda Product Film | Ice Impact, Bubble Burst and Can Return
content.summary: A copper herbal tonic moves from line construction through impact, opening and pour. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One graphic stroke becomes the complete product silhouette rather than an unrelated transition. + The impact leaves a persistent graphic consequence before the opening action. + Ice and vapor responses follow their visible triggers. + The pour connects the package to one readable serving state. + The final lockup restores complete packaging, palette and exact original typography.
quick_start.recommended_input: Draw one magenta diagonal stroke across an ivory field and fold it into an original copper tonic-can silhouette. Send six white geometric ice pieces outward and open the tab with one sharp vapor release. Align three complete cans behind the exact original word "VERRA", then return to one centered can and the line "COLD, CLEAR, HERBAL".
required_anchors: One graphic stroke becomes the complete product silhouette rather than an unrelated transition.
The impact leaves a persistent graphic consequence before the opening action.
The pour connects the package to one readable serving state.
The final lockup restores complete packaging, palette and exact original typography.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.

invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.

invariants.rule: Ice and vapor responses follow their visible triggers.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Ice and vapor responses follow their visible triggers."

invariants.rule: The final lockup restores complete packaging, palette and exact original typography.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final lockup restores complete packaging, palette and exact original typography."
